sources.title: LoRA Fine-tuning | QwenLM/Qwen-VL | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: LoRA is a parameter-efficient fine-tuning technique that significantly reduces memory requirements while maintaining model performance. This page covers the technical implementation, configuration options, and best practices for LoRA fine-tuning in the Qwen-VL repository.

sources.title: Language Model LoRA | 2U1/Qwen2-VL-Finetune | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Language Model LoRA Relevant source files This document covers Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) fine-tuning specifically applied to the language model components of Qwen2-VL models. This approach enables parameter-efficient training by freezing the base language model weights and adding trainable low-rank adapters to specific layers.
